title: Michael's fight with a sergeant at a missile site
place_text: Missile site, Ellsworth AFB missile field, South Dakota

tellings.quote: I remember I got into a fight with the sergeant at one of the missile one of the missile sites.

plain: Michael Johnson, an Air Force veteran who worked the nuclear missile sites around Ellsworth Air Force Base in South Dakota, says that in 1977 he got into a fight with a sergeant at one of the missile sites. He tells Michels he remembers it himself, as one of the pieces of that strange period he is trying to put back together.
